title: My mother came in my sleep

plan.english: Mother, why are you smiling this dawn? My mother came to me in sleep. She was beautiful, and she sang. What did she say to you? She said this. Come, daughter! The hearth is warm. Mother, do not go to her! I shall not go away this winter. I will see your grandson.

title: The debt of the hungry winter

plan.english: Heir, I owe a cow to our neighbor. Why do you owe him? In the winter of hunger he gave us grain. When I am gone, repay my debt. I will repay it today, and then your debt will be gone. Give him the best cow. Why shall I give the best one? Then our name will be good.

title: My fathers lie in this earth

plan.english: Father, we are driving the herds to new pastures. Come with us. My fathers lie in this earth. I will stay with them. Who will feed you? My nephew will feed me. We shall not see you again. Go, and remember me in the evenings. May the gods lead you.
